text:
Maria P: Draft ready — SI Activation Curriculum & ops walkthrough. Looking for a quick pass from partner-eng, training, and docs. TL;DR: 4 modules + instructor kit + 30q cert exam + cloud marketplace checklist. Draft: https://redwood.internal/si-activation/draft. Please review and comment by EOD Wed.

Alex G: :eyes: on it. Will validate learning objectives and timebox. Do we have hands-on lab infra? @Olga K

Olga K: We have a GCP sandbox with ephemeral creds. Need a runbook for seat provisioning and teardown. I'll add provisioning steps to the instructor kit.

Ben S: Quick Q — cert levels in the draft only list 'Associate' and 'Partner'. Do we want an 'Expert' track or keep it two-tier? Also what's the proposed pass threshold?

Maria P: Thinking Associate = 70%, Certified Partner = 85%. 'Expert' could be a separate practical assessment/workshop. Happy to iterate.

Jen L: Suggest we split the instructor kit into three artifacts: Quickstart PPT, Lab scripts (runnable), Troubleshooting cheat sheet. Easier for SIs to onboard their trainers. I can break the doc out.

Marco R: Recommend a 2-hr customer-facing workshop template and a one-pager for marketplace listing. I'll draft the marketplace copy and sample YAML.

si-onboarding-bot: Ticket created: PART-8345 — "SI activation - instructor kit and cert exam" assigned to @Alex G, due 2024-04-02.

Olga K: Adding placeholder for KMS/HSM notes (private deploys) and a privacy checklist for on-prem labs. Need to confirm what we can share as images/log samples.

Ben S: Also need marketplace requirements: screenshots, logos, SKU mapping, and support tiers. @Marco R can you own SKU mapping and sample listing?

Marco R: Yep. Will own SKU mapping and produce a sample YAML for the marketplace. Example snippet:
```
sku: redwood-si-basic
region: us-west-2
support_level: standard
```

Maria P: Can we sync Fri 10:00am for 30m to finalize design decisions? I'll send a calendar invite. Action items from this thread: Alex — finalize curriculum objectives; Jen — split docs into Quickstart/Labs/Cheat sheet; Marco — marketplace YAML + one-pager; Olga — lab provisioning runbook + privacy notes; Ben — cert thresholds + ops checklist.

Alex G: Will have learning objectives by Thu EOD.

Jen L: Docs draft by Thu.

Olga K: I'll scope and draft the runbook, include commands and ephemeral key steps.

Ben S: I'll draft the ops checklist and include on-call escalation and marketplace requirements.

Marco R: +1, will start YAML and workshop template.

Maria P: Thanks all :raised_hands: — I'll consolidate feedback into a single PR and link back here when ready.
